manufacturer.zh: 海南世电科技有限公司

description.en: Industrial edge computing gateway with 4G, Ethernet, LoRa, and RS485 connectivity. Supports edge computing, up to 128 connected devices, and 16 expandable I/O modules.
description.zh: 工业级边缘计算网关，支持4G、以太网、LoRa和RS485通信，边缘计算能力，最多128台设备接入，可扩展16个I/O模块。

lead.en: A powerful industrial edge computing gateway supporting LoRa wireless and RS485 wired convergence networks. Connects up to 128 wired/wireless devices, features 4G full Netcom and Ethernet dual-channel communication, edge computing engine, and seamless integration with the WEST-AIOT cloud platform.
lead.zh: 一款强大的工业级边缘计算网关，支持LoRa无线和RS485有线融合网络，最多接入128台有线/无线设备，具备4G全网通和以太网双通道通信，内置边缘计算引擎，可与WEST-AIOT云平台无缝对接。

product.og_description: Edge computing gateway with 4G/LoRa/RS485, supporting up to 128 devices and 16 I/O modules.

images.alt: WE-X280 edge computing gateway front view

text.en: Supports 4G full Netcom, Ethernet, LoRa (410–490MHz), and RS485 wired networks simultaneously for flexible device connectivity.
text.zh: 同时支持4G全网通、以太网、LoRa（410–490MHz）和RS485有线网络，实现灵活的设备连接。

text.en: Built-in edge computing capabilities for high-precision digital conversion, exception cleaning, protocol unification, and business logic calculation at the edge.
text.zh: 内置边缘计算能力，在边缘端完成高精度数模转换、异常清洗、协议统一和业务逻辑计算。

text.en: One gateway connects up to 128 wired/wireless sensing devices, with expandable support for up to 16 I/O node modules.
text.zh: 单台网关最多接入128台有线/无线传感设备，可扩展支持16个I/O节点模块。

text.en: 4G full Netcom (LTE FDD/TDD) and Ethernet (RJ45, 10/100M) dual-channel encrypted transmission to the cloud platform.
text.zh: 4G全网通（LTE FDD/TDD）和以太网（RJ45，10/100M）双通道加密传输至云平台。

text.en: Seamlessly connects to WEST-AIOT device management platform and third-party platforms via MQTT + custom JSON protocol.
text.zh: 通过MQTT+自定义JSON协议，无缝对接WEST-AIOT设备管理平台和第三方平台。

text.en: Rail-mounted design, ABS/PC housing, wide temperature range (-20°C to +70°C), CE certified for demanding industrial environments.
text.zh: 导轨式安装，ABS/PC外壳，宽温范围（-20°C至+70°C），CE认证，适应严苛工业环境。

value.en: LTE FDD B1/3/5/8; TDD B34/38/39/40/41; SMA female antenna
value.zh: LTE FDD B1/3/5/8；TDD B34/38/39/40/41；SMA母头天线接口
410.125–490.125MHz；22dBm发射功率；−147dBm接收灵敏度；5km视距通信

value.en: 1× expansion interface, supports up to 16 I/O modules

value.zh: 通过蓝牙进行本地配置
外置卡槽，支持断点续传

value.en: MQTT + custom JSON, WEST-AIOT platform compatible

text.en: Monitor and optimize energy consumption in office buildings, commercial real estate, and factories. Connect various sensors via LoRa and RS485 for comprehensive energy monitoring and emission reduction.
text.zh: 监控和优化办公楼、商业地产和工厂的能源消耗。通过LoRa和RS485连接各类传感器，实现全面的能源监测和节能减排。

text.en: Bridge distributed field devices to cloud SCADA and MQTT/HTTP endpoints. The edge computing engine processes data locally before secure uplink to the WEST-AIOT platform.
text.zh: 将分布式现场设备桥接到云SCADA和MQTT/HTTP终端。边缘计算引擎在数据安全上传到WEST-AIOT平台之前进行本地处理。
